definition: To impanel is to select and assign a jury for the purpose of deciding a case, also known as empanel. The usual steps of impaneling may include: 1. collecting the names of potential jurors in a random manner; 2. selecting the individuals who will serve on the jury; immunity / impanel Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026 3. giving potential jurors an opportunity to state the reasons why they should not serve on the jury; 4. allowing the defense and prosecution to use their challenges to dismiss potential jurors; 5. having jurors and alternate jurors sworn in.
